title: Erdoğan Announces Two New Gabar Oil Fields as COP31 Opens in Antalya
detail: Erdoğan announced the Gaziler and Çardaklı fields in Gabar (Şırnak), estimated at about 135 million barrels in place (not a recoverable-reserve figure); output began in October. Gabar currently yields about 84,000 bpd from 184 wells, roughly 8% of Türkiye's consumption, and officials expect regional output to rise 30% with ~230 wells by late 2027.
